item.title: Mittelstand hofft auf Strukturreformen unter künftigem Arbeitsminister Schweitzer
item.description: Der deutsche Mittelstand hofft auf rasche Reformen unter dem designierten Arbeitsminister Alexander Schweitzer. "Für den Mittelstand gilt es nun, die wichtigen Strukturreformen zügig umzusetzen", sagte Matthias Bianchi vom Deutschen Mittelstands-Bund (DMB) am Montag der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. "Die sozialen Sicherungssysteme müssen verlässlich und finanzierbar bleiben." Schweitzer selbst habe betont, wie eng wirtschaftliche Stärke, Investitionen und gute Arbeitsplätze zusammenhingen. Der eingeschlagene Reformkurs müsse mit vollem Einsatz und Tempo vorangetrieben werden.

Die SPD hat den früheren rheinland-pfälzischen Ministerpräsidenten Schweitzer für die Nachfolge an der Spitze des Arbeitsministeriums benannt. Zuvor hatte die bisherige Amtsinhaberin Bärbel Bas (SPD) ihren Rücktritt erklärt. Man habe Bas "als faire und streitbare Gesprächspartnerin erlebt, die dem Mittelstand offen begegnet ist und den Dialog konstruktiv geführt hat, auch bei unterschiedlichen Positionen", sagte DMB-Vertreter Bianchi.

item.title: Merz zollt Bas Respekt und dankt für ihr Engagement
item.description: Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz hat der am Montag zurückgetretenen Bundesarbeitsministerin Bärbel Bas (SPD) seinen Respekt ausgesprochen. item.content:encoded: Ein leichter Ölpreisrückgang und eine Entspannung im Handelsstreit zwischen der EU und China geben dem Dax (.GDAXI) Rückenwind. Der deutsche Leitindex notierte zur Eröffnung am Montag ein halbes Prozent höher bei 25.206,95 Punkten. Die Preise für Nordsee-Rohöl Brent und US-Leichtöl WTI lagen jeweils rund ein Prozent tiefer bei 104,02 und 90,93 Dollar je Fass (159 Liter). "Die Aussicht auf russische [USN:L8N45V1NP TEXT:"Diesellieferungen"] in die USA nimmt etwas Druck von den internationalen Energiemärkten", sagte Andreas Lipkow, Chefanalyst beim Broker CMC Markets. US-Präsident Donald Trump hat sich nach eigenen Angaben vom Freitag mit dem russischen Präsidenten Wladimir Putin auf umfangreiche Diesellieferungen geeinigt. Politisch bleibe die Entwicklung jedoch brisant, da sich damit auch die Kräfteverhältnisse im Ukraine-Krieg verschieben könnten, sagte Lipkow. Auch die Lage im Nahen Osten bleibt angespannt: Die jemenitischen Huthi-Rebellen haben ihre Angriffe auf Saudi-Arabien [USN:L8N45Y01O TEXT:"ausgeweitet"]. Bei den Einzelwerten griffen Anleger vor allem bei Automobilaktien zu. Für Auftrieb sorgte eine Einigung zwischen Europa und China über [USN:L8N45V17U TEXT:"Exportbeschränkungen"] für Hybridautos. "Besonders die europäischen Automobilwerte könnten davon profitieren", erläuterte Lipkow. Die Aktien von Porsche SE (PSHG_p.DE) , Volkswagen und Mercedes-Benz (MBGn.DE) rückten um jeweils rund 1,5 Prozent vor. Gefragt waren auch die Aktien von Nordex (NDXG.DE) . Der Windkraftanlagenbauer hat im dritten Quartal zahlreiche [USN:L8N45Y043 TEXT:"Aufträge"] eingeheimst, was die Papiere um drei Prozent nach oben trieb. Aus den Depots flogen hingegen die Titel von Aroundtown (AT1.DE) , die nach einer Herabstufung durch die US-Investmentbank Goldman Sachs 2,6 Prozent einbüßten.

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die Nachfrageschwäche bei Fahrzeugen von Volkswagen verschärft sich. Der konzernweite Absatz sei im dritten Quartal um 14,3 Prozent auf 1,88 Millionen Fahrzeuge zurückgegangen, teilte der Wolfsburger Autobauer am Montag mit. Der schwächste Markt war erneut China, wo die Verkäufe um 38,5 Prozent einbrachen. Lediglich in Zentral- und Osteuropa verbuchte der Dax-Konzern ein Mini-Plus von 1,4 Prozent. Für die ersten neun Monate des laufenden Jahres summiere sich der Absatz auf 6,01 Millionen Fahrzeuge. Dies sei ein Minus von neun Prozent. Das China-Geschäft schrumpfte in diesem Zeitraum um rund 30 Prozent. Auf Markenebene mussten Volkswagen und Audi im dritten Quartal jeweils Rückgänge von knapp 20 Prozent hinnehmen. Skoda konnte den Absatz stabil halten. Ein Lichtblick war dagegen die Nutzfahrzeugsparte Traton (8TRA.DE) . Sie wuchs um gut zehn Prozent. An der Börse legten die Papiere von Volkswagen zu Handelsbeginn 1,4 Prozent zu.

item.title: Saudi shares fall after second airport attack as Gulf trade stays cautious
item.description: Most Gulf markets crept higher in early Monday trade, with investors holding back from big bets due to uncertainty over the US-Iran conflict, while Saudi stocks retreated after a fresh attack weighed on sentiment.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Most Gulf markets crept higher in early Monday trade, with investors holding back from big bets due to uncertainty over the US-Iran conflict , while Saudi stocks retreated after a fresh attack weighed on sentiment. The [USN:L1N45X01E TEXT:"attack"] on Riyadh's international airport on Sunday left one person dead and nearly a dozen injured, according to Saudi authorities. The day before, a Houthi-claimed strike had killed 13 people and wounded more than 300. Saudi Arabia's benchmark index (.TASI) dropped 0.6%, with Al Rajhi Bank (1120.SE) losing 0.6% and oil major Saudi Aramco (2222.SE) down 0.3%. There was little sign of a diplomatic breakthrough in the US-Iran standoff over the Strait of Hormuz. State media on Sunday quoted Iran's security chief, Mohsen Rezaei, as saying the US had given an [USN:L1N45X04L TEXT:""insufficient" response"] to Tehran's seven conditions for reopening the vital waterway. The attacks also affected a major oil industry event in the kingdom, with a company spokesperson saying on Sunday BP's (BP.L) CEO [USN:L6N45X07U TEXT:"would not attend"] the World Petroleum Council Energy Congress in Riyadh. The Saudi energy ministry said the five-day conference went ahead as scheduled at a convention centre around 10 km (6.2 miles) from the targeted airport. Dubai's main share index (.DFMGI) inched 0.1% higher, while the Abu Dhabi index (.FTFADGI) added 0.1%. In Qatar, the index (.QSI) rose 0.5%, poised to claw back some of the 1.5% it lost in the prior session.

item.title: La ministre allemande du Travail démissionne après le décès de sa belle-fille
item.description: Bärbel Bas, ministre allemande du Travail et coprésidente du Parti social-démocrate (SPD, centre gauche), a démissionné lundi de ces deux fonctions, invoquant le décès de sa belle-fille et les attaques politiques de plus en plus virulentes dont elle a fait l'objet.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bärbel Bas, ministre allemande du Travail et coprésidente du Parti social-démocrate (SPD, centre gauche), a démissionné lundi de ces deux fonctions, invoquant le décès de sa belle-fille et les attaques politiques de plus en plus virulentes dont elle a fait l'objet. "Après le décès de ma belle-fille, j'ai pris conscience que j'avais besoin de temps pour faire mon deuil", a déclaré Bärbel Bas dans un communiqué. Cette démission porte un coup dur au gouvernement de coalition, dont le SPD fait partie, du chancelier conservateur (CDU) Friedrich Merz, déjà en [USN:L6N44Z0H5 TEXT:"grande difficulté"] après une série de revers électoraux, qui a notamment amené le parti d'extrême AfD aux portes du pouvoir dans le Land de [USN:L8N44Y0DJ TEXT:"Saxe-Anhalt"]. Bärbel Bas, dont le ministère supervise une grande partie du système de protection sociale allemand, a précisé avoir été confrontée à des "attaques publiques" de plus en plus nombreuses, notamment de la part de membres de la CDU/CSU. "Les attaques dont elle a fait l'objet ces derniers jours, alors qu'elle était en deuil, étaient inappropriées. C'est inacceptable", estime dans un communiqué Lars Klingbeil, vice-chancelier fédéral, ministre des Finances et coprésident du SPD. Le ministère allemand des Finances a annoncé que Lars Klingbeil annulait un déplacement prévu en Inde. Les partenaires de la coalition travaillent actuellement à la refonte du système de retraite par répartition afin de relever les défis démographiques, un élément clé d'un programme plus large de réformes économiques et sociales. Bärbel Bas a été critiquée par des membres du bloc conservateur en raison des retards pris dans la réforme des retraites. S'exprimant sur la plate-forme X, Friedrich Merz s'est montré conciliant en disant que la décision de Bärbel Bas devait être respectée et en la remerciant pour son engagement ainsi que pour leur étroite coopération. Le SPD a annoncé qu’Alexander Schweitzer, ancien ministre-président de Rhénanie-Palatinat et l'un des vice-présidents du parti, prendrait la relève au poste de ministre du Travail. Le nom de la personne appelée à succéder à Bärbel Bas, qui a dit qu'elle conservait son siège au Bundestag, à la coprésidence du SPD n'est pas encore connu.

item.content:encoded: El Fondo Monetario Internacional insta a sus Estados miembros a actuar con rapidez si observan un aumento de la inflación y a trabajar para reducir los elevados déficits, dijo el lunes la directora gerente del organismo, Kristalina Georgieva, quien señaló que la inflación persistente se ve impulsada por las inversiones en inteligencia artificial. Sin embargo, esto tenía consecuencias para los países en desarrollo y los mercados emergentes, que, según ella, se estaban "convirtiendo en víctimas del aumento de los rendimientos en las economías avanzadas", dijo.

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le borse europee guadagnano terreno trainate dai titoli bancari, mentre i prezzi del greggio scendono sulle speranze di una tregua energetica tra Russia e Ucraina. Gli investitori attendono intanto l’inizio della stagione delle trimestrali da cui potrebbero arrivare nuovi spunti di interesse. ** Intorno alle 9.30 l'indice paneuropeo Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) guadagna lo 0,56% a 635,11 punti. L'Ibex spagnolo (.IBEX) , ricco di titoli bancari, registra il balzo maggiore tra gli indici regionali, in rialzo dell'1,3%. ** I prezzi del greggio scendono sulla scia delle aspettative di un aumento delle forniture russe, dopo che il presidente degli Stati Uniti Donald Trump ha detto che Ucraina e Russia hanno concordato di sospendere gli attacchi alle rispettive infrastrutture energetiche a seguito di un accordo Usa-Russia sulla fornitura di diesel. ** I rendimenti dei titoli di Stato della zona euro sono in calo, contribuendo così ulteriormente a migliorare il clima di fiducia nei confronti degli asset più rischiosi. ** Gli investitori guarderanno ora alle trimestrali delle società europee per valutare lo stato di salute delle aziende in un contesto di incertezza geopolitica e di aumento del costo del denaro. ** LVMH (LVMH.PA) pubblicherà i risultati a mercati chiusi, mentre quelli del produttore di apparecchiature per semiconduttori ASML (ASML.AS) e della società di investimento EQT (EQTAB.ST) sono attesi nel corso della settimana. ** Tra i singoli titoli, NORDEX (NDXG.DE) guadagna il 3,7% dopo che il produttore di turbine eoliche onshore ha detto che gli ordini ricevuti per i propri progetti nel terzo trimestre sono aumentati del 30% su base annua.

item.title: Auto, colloqui approfonditi Cina-Ue su commercio veicoli ibridi ed elettrici
item.description: La Cina e l’Unione europea hanno tenuto “consultazioni approfondite” sul commercio di veicoli ibridi ed elettrici, cercando di trovare un punto di equilibrio tra le rispettive preoccupazioni economiche e commerciali, ha detto il ministero del Commercio cinese.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Cina e l’Unione europea hanno tenuto “consultazioni approfondite” sul commercio di veicoli ibridi ed elettrici, cercando di trovare un punto di equilibrio tra le rispettive preoccupazioni economiche e commerciali, ha detto il ministero del Commercio cinese. Per quanto riguarda i veicoli ibridi, le parti hanno concordato che la quota di esportazione assegnata a Pechino non dovrà essere inferiore a quella riservata ad altri fornitori e che le misure Ue non dovranno colpire specificamente i prodotti cinesi né discriminare le imprese nazionali. Cina e Ue hanno inoltre concordato di rivedere al rialzo le quote di esportazione dei veicoli ibridi sulla base dei dati relativi al 2025, al fine di garantire opportunità e una crescita stabile alle imprese cinesi, ha aggiunto il ministero in un comunicato.

item.title: Productivity gains from AI could help offset Asia's ageing population problem, IMF says
item.description: Artificial intelligence could help offset Asia's shrinking workforce as some countries' populations age, provided its adoption is scaled evenly across the region instead of deepening existing disparities, the International Monetary Fund said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Rae Wee
item.content:encoded: Artificial intelligence could help offset Asia's shrinking workforce as some countries' populations age, provided its adoption is scaled evenly across the region instead of deepening existing disparities, the International Monetary Fund said on Monday. Speaking at the launch of an IMF book on challenges and opportunities in Asia, IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva said demography, economic integration and technology, specifically AI, are the three big "transformations" facing the region. "AI is projected to lift up growth in advanced Asia, where the ageing populations are, somewhere between half a percentage and one percentage point... and what is amazing is that if the countries capture productivity and this growth, they will more than offset the demographic pressure," she said. Findings presented in the book show that countries such as China, Japan and South Korea could lose nearly 25% of their working population between now and 2050, a loss that could be offset by productivity gains made from AI. However, Krishna Srinivasan, director of the IMF's Asia and Pacific department, cautioned that policymakers must balance the benefits from AI adoption against the risk of a widening divergence across countries in Asia. "What matters is whether AI augments workers or automates jobs. Advanced economies, for sure, are more exposed, but they are also better placed to benefit. Emerging markets are less exposed, but also less in a position to capture the upside," Srinivasan said at the book launch, which was part of IMF and World Bank annual meetings in Bangkok. "The good news here is reforms that raise skills and productivity can bring adoption forward by a decade or more." Georgieva also said deeper regional trade agreements and a reduction in non-tariff barriers could raise Asia's GDP by about 1.8% in the long run.

item.title: Inwit, azionisti Ardian e Oak studiano offerta su minoranze per delisting
item.description: Gli azionisti di riferimento di Inwit stanno lavorando al finanziamento di un possibile offerta per il delisting della società.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Gli azionisti di riferimento di Inwit (INWT.MI) stanno lavorando al finanziamento di un possibile offerta per il delisting della società. È quanto hanno riferito ieri due fonti vicine alla vicenda, mentre la società delle torri di telecomunicazione è alle prese con una disputa contrattuale con i suoi due maggiori clienti. La società francese di private equity Ardian e il veicolo di investimento Oak Holdings 1 - quest’ultimo sostenuto dai coinvestitori Gip, Vodafone (VOD.L) e Kkr (KKR.N) - stanno valutando un’offerta per l’acquisizione delle minorities di Inwit, hanno riferito le fonti. Ardian detiene il 32% di Inwit, mentre Oak Holdings il 39%. Le fonti hanno detto che gli azionisti stanno discutendo il finanziamento dell’offerta con le banche e una ha aggiunto che, nell’ambito del piano, la società di investimento di Abu Dhabi Mubadala dovrebbe acquisire una partecipazione in Inwit. Le fonti hanno precisato che le trattative sono ancora in corso. Ardian, Gip, Vodafone (VOD.L) , KKR (KKR.N) e Mubadala non hanno commentato. Gip fa parte della società di investimento statunitense Blackrock (BLK.N) . Un portavoce di Inwit ha detto che la società non dispone di alcuna informazione in merito. Inwit, quotata alla Borsa di Milano dal 2015, è stata oggetto di speculazioni su una possibile acquisizione da quando, a febbraio, un'indiscrezione stampa francese aveva riferito che il fondo infrastrutturale Ardian e il gruppo di investimento Brookfield erano interessati a ritirare dal listino la società italiana. Da allora Inwit è rimasta invischiata in una controversia con i suoi due principali clienti - Tim (TLIT.MI) e Fastweb (SCMN.S) - che hanno entrambi avviato le procedure per rescindere i rispettivi contratti nel tentativo di rinegoziarli a condizioni più favorevoli.

item.content:encoded: Más de 100 excursionistas extranjeros se encuentran varados en distintos lugares después de que la crecida de un río en el centro de Nepal durante el fin de semana arrasara rutas de senderismo y puentes, informó el lunes un responsable. Las autoridades rescataron a 96 personas, entre ellas nueve extranjeros, después de que un deslizamiento de tierra ocurrido el domingo en el distrito de Gorkha, a unos 100 kilómetros al oeste de Katmandú, bloqueara el río Budhi Gandaki, lo que provocó inundaciones río abajo. El río es un afluente del Trishuli, situado aguas abajo de otro afluente donde el derrumbe de un glaciar provocó en agosto una inundación catastrófica que se cobró la vida de 1.457 personas, y miles siguen todavía desaparecidas. El ejército indicó que la operación de rescate continuaba el lunes, a pesar de que la crecida ya había remitido. No se han registrado víctimas mortales, pero cinco habitantes del pueblo están ilocalizables después de que el río desbordado, que arrastraba lodo negro y escombros, arrasara viviendas y dañara infraestructuras, incluidas tres centrales hidroeléctricas, según las autoridades nacionales de gestión de catástrofes. Bhuwan Raj Ojha, responsable del Proyecto del Área de Conservación de Manaslu (MACP, por sus siglas en inglés), que incluye una popular ruta de senderismo, dijo que había más de 100 excursionistas extranjeros varados en diferentes zonas que no podían regresar porque parte del sendero había sido arrasado. "Hay que rescatar a los excursionistas que quieran regresar a causa de la inundación. Los que quieran continuar su ruta de senderismo pueden hacerlo desde lugares que sean seguros", declaró Ojha a Reuters desde Gorkha. "Hay restaurantes y casas de té a lo largo de la ruta. Son lugares seguros". El Centro Internacional para el Desarrollo Integrado de las Montañas (ICIMOD, por sus siglas en inglés) señaló que la más reciente inundación podría haber sido provocada por el colapso de una barrera fluvial temporal creada por un deslizamiento de tierra, según los informes preliminares de las autoridades nepalíes revisados por el ICIMOD. "Este suceso es otro recordatorio de lo expuestas que siguen estando las comunidades de montaña y los corredores fluviales a peligros repentinos y en cadena", dijo Pema Gyamtsho, director general del ICIMOD. "Si bien las labores de respuesta deben seguir siendo la prioridad inmediata, comprender qué provocó esta inundación será fundamental para reducir los riesgos futuros y reforzar la resiliencia".

item.title: La ministra de Trabajo alemana dimite tras la muerte de su hijastra
item.description: Bärbel Bas, ministra de Trabajo de Alemania y copresidenta del Partido Socialdemócrata (SPD), dimitió el lunes de ambos cargos, alegando el fallecimiento de su hijastra y los crecientes ataques políticos en su contra, lo que supone un duro golpe para el Gobierno de coalición del canciller Friedrich Merz.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bärbel Bas, ministra de Trabajo de Alemania y copresidenta del Partido Socialdemócrata (SPD), dimitió el lunes de ambos cargos, alegando el fallecimiento de su hijastra y los crecientes ataques políticos en su contra, lo que supone un duro golpe para el Gobierno de coalición del canciller Friedrich Merz. "Tras la muerte de mi hijastra, me di cuenta de que necesito tiempo para superar mi dolor", dijo Bas en un comunicado. Bas, cuyo ministerio supervisa gran parte del sistema de prestaciones sociales alemán, también señaló que se había enfrentado a crecientes "ataques públicos", incluso por parte de miembros del bloque conservador CDU/CSU, socios de coalición del SPD. El vicecanciller y ministro de Finanzas, Lars Klingbeil, el otro colíder del SPD, dijo en un comunicado: "Los ataques contra ella durante los últimos días de su duelo han sido inapropiados. Eso es inaceptable". El Ministerio de Finanzas de Klingbeil comunicó que este cancelaría un viaje previsto a India, cuyo inicio estaba programado para más tarde este lunes. La salida de Bas aumenta la presión sobre el Gobierno de coalición liderado por Merz, que se ha visto en apuros en las encuestas de opinión y afectado por los resultados de las elecciones regionales del mes pasado, en las que tanto la extrema derecha como la extrema izquierda obtuvieron importantes avances. El SPD anunció que Alexander Schweitzer, ex ministro presidente del estado de Renania-Palatinado y uno de los vicepresidentes del partido, asumiría el cargo de ministro de Trabajo. Aún no estaba claro quién sucedería a Bas como colíder del SPD. Bas dijo que mantendría su escaño en el Parlamento.

item.title: Skies over Saudi capital Riyadh largely empty after deadly Houthi strikes on airport
item.description: The Saudi capital's airport was closed after an attack that killed one person and injured nearly a dozen others.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The skies above the Saudi capital Riyadh were largely empty on Monday after [USN:L1N45X01E TEXT:"deadly attacks"] by Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis on the city's airport, with about 60% of scheduled flights expected to be cancelled, according to aviation analytics firm Cirium. King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia's second-busiest airport after Jeddah, cancelled 99.7% of all scheduled flights on Sunday, Cirium data showed. More than a third of flights scheduled across the kingdom were not expected to operate on Monday, while flight tracking website FlightRadar24 estimated cancellations at Riyadh airport of about 78%. The Saudi capital's airport remained closed on Sunday after an attack that killed one person and injured nearly a dozen others. The strike followed another attack claimed by the Houthis a day earlier that killed 13 people and wounded more than 300. The attacks marked one of the most significant disruptions to Saudi civil aviation in years, forcing airlines across Europe and Asia to suspend services. The Federal Aviation Administration told US airlines on Sunday to [USN:L1N45X078 TEXT:"exercise caution"] when flying to or over Saudi Arabia. Lufthansa Group (LHAG.DE) [USN:L6N45U10R TEXT:"has cancelled"] all flights to Riyadh until October 16, while Air France-KLM (AIRF.PA) has extended a previous suspension of services to and from the Saudi capital until the end of the month.

item.title: Top oil executives dropped from event schedule after Riyadh attacks
item.description: The chief executives of ExxonMobil, TotalEnergies, Shell, Chevron and BP were no longer on the conference agenda.
item.dc:creator: Sarah Safty, Jana Choukeir
item.content:encoded: Several top energy executives were dropped from the schedule of the WPC Energy Congress in Riyadh, as Saudi authorities pressed ahead with the event despite deadly attacks on the capital claimed by Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis. The chief executives of ExxonMobil, TotalEnergies, Shell, Chevron and BP had all been expected at the event, which began on Sunday, but were no longer on the agenda conference organisers released early Monday. “To everyone who travelled to Riyadh, thank you,” said Saudi Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman, who opened Monday’s session of the gathering for energy policy and industry that takes place once every three years. “You know this country is safe and that we hold your protection at whole heart…Our gathering here does not mean the risk is gone.” Prince Abdulaziz said the events of recent weeks were serious and that the kingdom’s response must be “equally serious". The strikes are a blow to Vision 2030, Saudi Arabia's multi-billion-dollar programme to diversify the economy away from oil, modernise society and position the kingdom as an investment and tourism hub. Hosting international events is a priority of the programme, which was already facing delays and recalibrations. Prince Abdulaziz said the kingdom must remain focused on the decades ahead and Vision 2030 must continue. A BP spokesperson said the company had "made every effort to participate" in the conference. "Unfortunately, due to travel disruption we are unable to be there in person. We greatly value our long-standing partnerships across the region." Shell declined to comment and TotalEnergies, ExxonMobil and Chevron did not immediately respond to Reuters' request for comment. The WPC Energy Congress is taking place this week at a conference centre some 10 kilometres (6 miles) from Riyadh’s international airport, which has been attacked four times in the last week. One person was killed and nearly a dozen hurt in a new attack on the airport on Sunday evening, Saudi authorities reported, a day after a strike claimed by Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis killed 13 people and wounded more than 300, the deadliest attack in the kingdom in more than a decade.

item.title: Stellantis to build small electric vehicles with Leapmotor
item.description: Stellantis plans to build small electric vehicles in Pomigliano, Italy, based on the e-car platform being developed together with Leapmotor in Mirafiori, the company's chief technology officer Ned Curic said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Stellantis (STLAM.MI) plans to build small electric vehicles in Pomigliano, Italy, based on the e-car platform being developed together with Leapmotor (9863.HK) in Mirafiori, the company's chief technology officer Ned Curic said on Monday. Stellantis is learning from Leapmotor to go faster and has learned to build a new car in two years, he added.

item.title: Chinese wealth manager CreditEase placed under criminal investigation
item.description: Police in Beijing's Chaoyang district have opened a criminal investigation into Chinese wealth manager CreditEase and imposed "criminal coercive measures" on its controller and several other suspects, Beijing police said in a statement on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Police in Beijing's Chaoyang district have opened a criminal investigation into Chinese wealth manager CreditEase and imposed "criminal coercive measures" on its controller and several other suspects, Beijing police said in a statement on Monday. The case marks a fresh step in Beijing's push to tackle the complex lending hidden in the shadow banking sector, which regulators have spent years trying to unwind. The suspects include CreditEase's actual controller, a 53-year-old man surnamed Tang, and a 51-year-old woman surnamed Zhao, the statement said. It urged investors to register their cases with police and cooperate with efforts to recover assets and minimise losses. The announcement follows CreditEase's abrupt suspension in May of redemptions on quasi-fixed-income products worth 30 billion yuan ($4.5 billion), according to a letter sent to some of its investors on Sunday, local media outlet Yicai reported. In the letter, the company said it had commissioned a third-party firm to audit its assets and liabilities, and that financial due diligence advisers had preliminarily found CreditEase Group may be "insolvent, with a large debt repayment gap", according to the report. CreditEase did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Founded in 2006, Beijing-based CreditEase launched peer-to-peer (P2P) platform Yirendai in 2012 and listed it in New York in 2015, making it the first Chinese P2P lender to go public overseas. After a wave of P2P platforms collapsed in 2018, CreditEase later shifted to a loan facilitation model to comply with tighter regulation. It transitioned to a model that helps banks and other institutions extend loans, and it also sells wealth management products to high-net-worth clients. Yiren Digital, its US-listed arm, reported a net loss of 944 million yuan for the first half of 2026, compared with a net profit of 605 million yuan in the first half of 2025. Beijing has in recent years stepped up efforts to minimise shadow banking risks and contain systemic financial risk. In April, a Beijing court ordered the [USN:L1N40W099 TEXT:"liquidation"] of Zhongzhi Enterprise Group and more than 300 related entities, a major step towards resolving one of China's biggest shadow banking collapses. ($1 = 6.6921 Chinese yuan renminbi)

item.title: Emerging Asia's power-driven LNG demand at risk as renewables gain ground
item.description: Emerging Asia is losing its appetite for liquefied natural gas to generate power as geopolitical shocks, equipment shortages and cheaper renewables derail projects, disappointing industry hopes the region would drive the next wave of demand.
item.dc:creator: Emily Chow
item.content:encoded: Emerging Asia is losing its appetite for liquefied natural gas to generate power as geopolitical shocks, equipment shortages and cheaper renewables derail projects, disappointing industry hopes the region would drive the next wave of demand. Countries including Vietnam and the Philippines had planned new LNG import terminals and power plants to meet rising demand and transition from coal, but the market shocks of Russia's 2022 Ukraine invasion and the ongoing US-Iran war sent prices soaring, exposing the risks of LNG reliance. Since then, several projects in the region have stalled while buildout plans for others have fallen behind targets, with a global gas turbine [USN:L6N3XF17A TEXT:"shortage"] contributing to the slowdown. With renewable generation costs falling, governments are accelerating their clean energy deployment to cut import fuel dependency. The International Energy Agency forecast in October that wind and solar energy will contribute 11% of Southeast Asia's energy mix by 2030, up from 5% in 2025. "As gas project delays mount and supply chains tighten, policymakers are being forced to rethink not only the role of gas in the near term, but also the long-term pathways to achieving their energy transition goals," said Wei Han Tan, Southeast Asia power and renewables analyst at Wood Mackenzie. "Countries will need to look elsewhere to meet rising demand", he said, by adding to existing coal fleets and speeding up renewables deployment. Wood Mackenzie estimates that only 14.9 gigawatts of Southeast Asia's planned 53 GW of gas-fired power projects in the pipeline will come online by 2030, with Vietnam seeing the biggest shortfall in projects with 25.7 GW unlikely to start by then. Even before the Iran war, gas-fired power generation was losing ground across some emerging Asian economies, data from energy think tank Ember shows. Gas-fired power output has declined in Bangladesh, Pakistan and India in the last five years as coal and renewables expand, while gas has struggled to expand its share of [USN:L4N42Q0UP TEXT:"China's"] power mix. In Southeast Asia, gas generation volumes have been stable in the last decade, but have steadily lost share to expanding renewable capacity. TRANSITION NOW Since the US-Israeli war on Iran began on February 28, emerging Asian markets have accelerated plans for alternative power sources. [USN:SPN45600N TEXT:"Bangladesh"] and [USN:L6N45A0FW TEXT:"Thailand"] announced solar rollout plans, while [USN:L4N43A0F1 TEXT:"Vietnam"] is considering increasing coal-fired generation. Thailand, which imports a fifth of its LNG from Qatar, must secure alternative near-term supplies but speed its energy transition in the long run, its energy minister told Reuters last month. In [USN:L4N42T047 TEXT:"the Philippines"], rooftop solar installations to offset high electricity prices are rising, while at least three LNG-related projects there have been halted in the last two years. One project in the Philippines stalled after developer Energy World Corp sold the gas turbine for its power plant for nearly four times what it paid a decade ago, saying rapid renewable energy growth was reducing the need for gas-fired generation. The company intends to build the site as an import terminal, according to its website. Irtiza Sayyed, the chief executive of JERA Global Energy Solutions, said power infrastructure development in emerging economies has slowed as they compete globally with data centres for gas turbines. JERA is Japan's top power generator and is looking to sell LNG in South and Southeast Asia. REDUCE VOLATILITY To be sure, overall LNG demand in emerging Asia is still likely to rise as economies grow and domestic gas production wanes, with Wood Mackenzie forecasting Southeast Asian consumption rising to 39 million metric tons by 2028, from 27 million in 2025. LNG proponents also say gas is needed for grid reliability and flexible power generation, while planned data centre capacity could boost power-sector demand. But governments planning for the next decade will likely turn to additional renewable energy amid gas price uncertainty, said Rystad Energy analyst Lu Ming Pang. The firm has cut its long-term Asia LNG demand forecasts by 3% for 2040, and 7% by 2045, as countries including Vietnam and the Philippines have not secured sufficient LNG supply deals and infrastructure, while China accelerates its renewable energy buildout.

item.title: Burnham comunicará al Parlamento que Reino Unido debe plantearse un nuevo acuerdo con la UE
item.description: El primer ministro Andy Burnham comunicará este lunes al Parlamento que Reino Unido debe plantearse una nueva relación más estrecha con la Unión Europea, y afirmará que un nuevo acuerdo con el bloque tras el Brexit podría impulsar el crecimiento y ayudar a controlar la inmigración.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El primer ministro Andy Burnham comunicará este lunes al Parlamento que Reino Unido debe plantearse una nueva relación más estrecha con la Unión Europea, y afirmará que un nuevo acuerdo con el bloque tras el Brexit podría impulsar el crecimiento y ayudar a controlar la inmigración. Burnham, que hizo campaña a favor de la permanencia de Reino Unido en la Unión Europea en el referéndum de 2016 sobre la pertenencia a la UE, marcará el fin del receso parlamentario el lunes con una declaración ante los diputados centrada en la postura del país respecto al bloque. A diferencia de su predecesor, Keir Starmer, que evitó reavivar un debate divisivo que se prolonga desde hace años sobre la UE, Burnham defiende que Reino Unido no se ha beneficiado del Brexit y que debería volver a analizar las relaciones con "serenidad y lucidez". "Andy entiende por qué algunos políticos no quieren afrontar la realidad de que el Brexit no ha cumplido lo que en su día prometieron. Pero es hora de entablar un diálogo diferente sobre cómo debería ser nuestra relación a largo plazo", dijo una fuente de la oficina de Burnham en Downing Street. "Mantener el statu quo y no trabajar sin descanso para conseguir un buen acuerdo que impulse el crecimiento supondría un grave incumplimiento del deber". Hará un llamamiento a todos los partidos para que apoyen su enfoque, argumentando que sería irresponsable ignorar la posibilidad de un nuevo acuerdo. En la conferencia anual de su Partido Laborista celebrada el mes pasado, Burnham aprovechó un discurso para defender que era hora de que Reino Unido considerara opciones para su relación con la UE, incluida la reincorporación, una sugerencia que fue recibida con recelo por algunos de los líderes del bloque. Desde el Brexit, el interés en Reino Unido por volver a integrarse en el bloque ha aumentado en los últimos años y, según las encuestas de opinión, la mayoría de los británicos se muestra a favor, aunque el apoyo suele disminuir cuando se pregunta a la gente sobre la contribución a los presupuestos de la UE y la adopción del euro.

item.content:encoded: L'Union européenne (UE) a trouvé un accord portant sur la limitation des importations de véhicules hybrides chinois à 350.000 unités par an, avec une hausse annuelle de 6%, dans le cadre d'un accord de quatre ans annoncé vendredi, a déclaré lundi un responsable de la Commission européenne. item.title: German regulator gives Deutsche Post scope to hike letter prices
item.description: Germany's regulator said on Monday that DHL's Deutsche Post may increase letter prices, given a sharp decline in the volume of letters, and offered its proposal for postage rate increases.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Germany's regulator said on Monday that DHL's Deutsche Post (DHLn.DE) may increase letter prices, given a sharp decline in the volume of letters, and offered its proposal for postage rate increases. Deutsche Post may increase letter prices by 20.35% and prices for private customer parcels by 10.72%, the Federal Network Agency said. The agency said it has remained below Deutsche Post's requested adjustments and has not taken into account rising value-added and overhead costs claimed by the company. It said the new rates are intended to apply in the years 2027 and 2028. Deutsche Post, competitors, consumer protection organisations and other interested parties may submit comments on the proposed decision by October 30. The final decision is expected to be published in November.

item.title: More than 100 foreign trekkers stranded in flood-hit region of Nepal, official says
item.description: More than 100 foreign trekkers are stranded at different locations after the flooding of a river in central Nepal at the weekend swept away hiking trails and bridges, an official said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Gopal Sharma
item.content:encoded: More than 100 foreign trekkers are stranded at different locations after the flooding of a river in central Nepal at the weekend swept away hiking trails and bridges, an official said on Monday. Authorities rescued 96 people including nine foreigners after a landslide on Sunday in Gorkha district, about 100 km (62 miles) west of Kathmandu, blocked the Budhi Gandaki River, leading to downstream flooding. The river is a tributary of the Trishuli River, downstream from another tributary where a glacier collapse caused a catastrophic flood in August that killed 1,457 people, with thousands still missing. The army said the latest rescue operation was continuing on Monday even as the flood has receded. There were no reports of fatalities, but five villagers are out of contact after the flooded river carrying black muddy sludge and debris washed away homes and damaged infrastructure including three hydroelectric plants, national disaster authorities said. Bhuwan Raj Ojha, an official of the Manaslu Conservation Area Project (MACP) that includes a popular trekking route, said there were more than 100 foreign trekkers stranded in different areas who could not return because part of the trail had been swept away. "Those hikers who want to return because of the flood need to be rescued. Those who want to continue their trekking can do so from locations that are safe," Ojha told Reuters from Gorkha. "There are restaurants and tea houses along the route. They are safe." The International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development said the latest flood may have been triggered by the failure of a temporary river blockage created by a landslide, according to preliminary accounts from Nepal's authorities reviewed by ICIMOD. "This event is another reminder of how exposed mountain communities and river corridors remain to sudden, cascading hazards," Pema Gyamtsho, director general of ICIMOD, said. "While response efforts must remain the immediate priority, understanding what triggered this flood will be critical for reducing future risks and strengthening resilience."

item.title: Wildfires spread into residential areas in Indonesia's Bangka Belitung, destroying over 300 houses
item.description: Forest and land fires in Indonesia's Bangka Belitung province have spread into a densely populated residential area, the local disaster mitigation agency said on Monday, damaging at least 300 houses and forcing the evacuation of 500 people.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Forest and land [USN:L4N45R0J5 TEXT:"fires"] in Indonesia's Bangka Belitung province have spread into a densely populated residential area, the local disaster mitigation agency said on Monday, damaging at least 300 houses and forcing the evacuation of 500 people. The fire began on Saturday afternoon in Serdang village in the region of South Bangka, and continued until late on Sunday, the agency said in a statement Indonesia is [USN:L6N4590IW TEXT:"battling"] its most intense wildfires in 11 years, mainly on the islands of Sumatra and Borneo This is the first time this year that wildfires have caused damage to hundreds of houses [USN:L1N45807M TEXT:"Strong winds"] enabled the fire to spread into the residential areas, where 305 houses were completely destroyed, the agency said At least 1,800 people were affected by the fire, and around 500 people were evacuated to the nearest school building and mosque, the agency said, adding that no casualties have been reported The blaze had burned 8.3 hectares (20.51 acres) of land Strong winds, peatland terrain, limited water supplies and the use of wood to construct houses in the affected settlements had made it more difficult for firefighters to contain the fires, the agency said The agency has also set up evacuation tents and a public kitchen, and has distributed food, water and clothing From January through July this year, fires scorched around 202,000 hectares (499,153 acres) across Indonesia Non-governmental organisations estimate that an additional 600,000 hectares or more may have been burned in the months that followed

item.title: Siberian hunters declare open season on bears after spate of deadly attacks
item.description: A brown bear bounds across the Siberian taiga before two hunters close in on their prey. Three shots ring out and the bear quickly drops dead in the long grass.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A brown bear bounds across the Siberian taiga before two hunters close in on their prey. Three shots ring out and the bear quickly drops dead in the long grass. Cradling his rifle as he rests his hand on the dead animal's fur, hunter Mikhail Kondakov says he and others have heeded requests from residents in the nearby settlement of Podtesovo after a fatal bear attack on local women. "The bear situation in the settlement is very difficult at the moment," Kondakov told Reuters. "Bears have increasingly been coming directly into the settlement. This year we had a tragedy — two women who went mushroom picking were killed by a man-eating bear. We decided to start hunting bears because there are so many of them." BEAR POPULATION HAS SPIRALLED OUT OF CONTROL The problem is nationwide. The Russian government said last month it was drawing up urgent measures [USN:L8N45M1D8 TEXT:"to control the population of brown bears"] that has spiralled out of control in some regions, with at least 22 people killed in attacks since this spring, according to state media. The population of brown bears has more than doubled in the last three decades to 308,000 according to government data, in part due to shorter and milder winters. Experts cited in Russian media have said bears have been forced to look further afield for food this year because an early and dry spring meant there was a lack of berries for them to feed on. People have also been blamed for leaving food waste out in the open where it attracts bears and for ignoring safety rules. In Krasnoyarsk, the Siberian region where Kondakov is hunting and which is home to nearly 27,000 bears, investigators said last month that they had [USN:L1N45H0JI TEXT:"opened a criminal case into the local environment ministry"], accusing it of failing to keep bear numbers under control, negligence which they said had led to the deaths of seven people in September alone. In Podtesovo, a settlement of around 3,500 people perched on the right bank of the River Yenisei, a simple wooden cross stands on the grave of Zoya Gubanova along with a colour photograph of the late pensioner. Gubanova, 67, was killed on August 31 in a bear attack while out gathering mushrooms, a popular Russian pastime. Chatting outside her wooden house, Yulia Markova, a local resident, says the situation has become intolerable. "We have been living in fear for almost two months now, we cannot even go out for a walk in the evening. People are afraid to let their children go out alone. This is not a cuddly toy, it is not some soft, harmless teddy bear. It is a wild animal. And who knows what its intentions are, what kind of mood it is in when it comes here. Maybe it is simply curious, or maybe it is looking for its next victim," she said. Markova said that locals, like bear attack victim Gubanova, had not fully understood the danger posed by bears and that people had initially felt sorry for them because they clearly did not have enough nuts and berries to eat this year. But she said hearts had hardened after the bears started coming into the settlement in large numbers. "We have never seen an invasion like this before," said Markova. BEARS COMING INTO PARKS WHERE CHILDREN PLAY Watching her daughter relax at the local playground, pregnant mother Valeriya Efremova said heightened bear activity had changed locals' lives. "When the bears started coming out of the forest, we restricted outings as much as possible, even to the park. It was really frightening because bears were even coming into the park where children play. Going out after dark was absolutely out of the question. Even now, although the number of sightings seems to have fallen, at least according to the information we have, you still walk around looking over your shoulder," she said. Nikolai Zhilinsky, another local, said people were waiting for the weather to get colder and for the bears to hibernate, but he said people would still be worried even when that happened. "We are not sure that all of the bears will hibernate. There are too many of them and they are hungry," he said. He was afraid to go fishing in his boat in case he was attacked by a bear, he added. Vladimir Vagin, another local, said people feared they could be attacked in their own gardens. He pointed to an area near a raspberry bush in his own garden where he believed a bear had been. Driving through the settlement after dark, he noted how empty the streets were. "People don't go out because they are afraid," he said.

item.title: Burnham to tell parliament UK needs to consider new deal with EU
item.description: Prime Minister Andy Burnham will tell parliament on Monday Britain must consider a new, closer relationship with the European Union, saying a new post-Brexit deal with the bloc could boost growth and help control immigration.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Prime Minister Andy Burnham will tell parliament on Monday Britain must consider a new, closer relationship with the European Union, saying a new [USN:L1N45M0A5 TEXT:"post-Brexit deal"] with the bloc could boost growth and help control immigration. [USN:L8N45K17W TEXT:"Burnham"], who campaigned for Britain to stay in the EU in a 2016 referendum on membership, will mark the end of a parliamentary recess on Monday with a statement to lawmakers focusing on the nation's approach to the bloc. In a break with his predecessor, [USN:L8N41P1MT TEXT:"Keir Starmer"], who steered clear of restarting a years-long divisive debate over the EU, Burnham is making the case that Britain has not benefited from Brexit and should again take a "calm, clear-eyed look" at ties. "Andy understands why some politicians don't want to face up to the reality that Brexit has not delivered what they once promised. But it is time for a different conversation about what our long-term relationship should be," a source in Burnham's Downing Street office said. "Sticking with the status quo and not working relentlessly to secure a good deal that boosts growth would be a major dereliction of duty." He will call on all parties to support his approach by saying it would be irresponsible to ignore the possibility of a new deal. At his Labour Party's [USN:L1N45L05W TEXT:"annual conference"] last month, Burnham used a speech to argue it was time for Britain to [USN:L1N45M0A5 TEXT:"consider options"] for its relationship with the EU, including rejoining - a suggestion that was met warily by some of the bloc's leaders. Since Brexit, the appetite in Britain to rejoin the bloc has improved in recent years with most Britons in favour, according to opinion polls, but support often drops when people are asked about contributing to EU budgets and adopting the euro.

item.title: Intel CEO says Chinese frontier AI model adoption has been 'very fast'
item.description: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan said on Monday that the token costs of Chinese frontier AI models have been lower and adoption has been "very fast".
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Intel (INTC.O) CEO Lip-Bu Tan said on Monday that the token costs of Chinese frontier AI models have been lower and adoption has been "very fast". At a panel organised by lender DBS on Monday, Tan said the performances of Chinese models, such as DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM, are "good enough". "I'm a strong believer of open source, that's the best way to drive efficiency," he said, adding that markets will decide which models will benefit different use cases the most. He added that quantum computing could become mainstream in the next three to five years and that software will play a role in driving the efficient use of some of the infrastructure that will be required.

item.title: Moonshot negocia la resolución de la disputa con un accionista antes de salir a bolsa
item.description: Los altos directivos de la "startup" china de IA Moonshot están manteniendo conversaciones, antes de su salida a bolsa prevista en Hong Kong, para resolver un litigio con un accionista que exige una indemnización por sus presuntas irregularidades, según fuentes cercanas al proceso.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los altos directivos de la "startup" china de IA Moonshot están manteniendo conversaciones, antes de su salida a bolsa prevista en Hong Kong, para resolver un litigio con un accionista que exige una indemnización por sus presuntas irregularidades, según fuentes cercanas al proceso. Recurrent.ai, una empresa desarrolladora de software de IA, y algunos de sus inversionistas han acusado al director ejecutivo de Moonshot, Yang Zhilin, y al director de tecnología, Zhang Yutao, de realizar declaraciones falsas a los inversionistas de Recurrent y de enriquecerse a costa de esta última, según una carta del 11 de marzo enviada por los abogados de Recurrent a los inversionistas de Moonshot, a la que ha tenido acceso Reuters. Yang y Zhang Yutao cofundaron Recurrent.ai en 2016, antes de crear Moonshot en 2023, y siguen siendo directores de la sociedad matriz de Recurrent, según los registros mercantiles. Hasta ahora no se había publicado ninguna información en prensa sobre las negociaciones para llegar a un acuerdo. Reuters no pudo verificar de forma independiente la veracidad de las afirmaciones contenidas en la carta. La misiva no mencionaba los nombres de los inversionistas de Recurrent. Yang y Zhang Yutao no respondieron a las solicitudes de comentarios enviadas por correo electrónico. Yang ya había negado anteriormente las acusaciones. Moonshot no quiso hacer comentarios. David Morrison, socio principal de MinterEllison —el bufete que representa a Yang, Zhang Yutao y Moonshot—, dijo a medios chinos en noviembre de 2024 que el caso "carecía de fundamento tanto jurídico como fáctico" y que el bufete prepararía una defensa. Reuters no pudo determinar si Zhang Yutao se ha pronunciado públicamente sobre las acusaciones. Recurrent no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios enviada por correo electrónico. Moonshot, con sede en Pekín, forma parte de un grupo de desarrolladores chinos de IA —entre los que se incluye DeepSeek— que está desafiando el dominio de empresas estadounidenses como OpenAI y Anthropic. Según informó Reuters en septiembre, Moonshot presentó de forma confidencial una solicitud de salida a bolsa en Hong Kong, con el objetivo de sacar partido de la popularidad de sus modelos de IA Kimi. Aunque no se espera que la disputa ponga en peligro los planes de salida a bolsa de Moonshot, un conflicto sin resolver con Recurrent podría plantear cuestiones de gobernanza, propiedad y transparencia para los posibles inversionistas, y complicar el proceso de cotización, según una de las personas con conocimiento de la disputa. Las fuentes cercanas al asunto dijeron que desconocían si se avecinaba un acuerdo. La Bolsa de Hong Kong y la Comisión de Valores y Futuros, que regula el sector financiero de la ciudad, no quisieron hacer comentarios. La Comisión Reguladora de Valores de China y la Administración del Ciberespacio de China, uno de los principales organismos reguladores de la IA del país, no respondieron a las solicitudes de comentarios. DEMANDA DE RECURRENT CONTRA LOS DIRECTIVOS DE MOONSHOT La disputa, que se encuentra en proceso de arbitraje en Hong Kong, se remonta a 2024. Recurrent ha acusado a Yang y a Zhang Yutao de fundar Moonshot sin autorización del directorio de Recurrent, de realizar declaraciones falsas a los inversionistas y de enriquecerse a costa de Recurrent, según la carta de marzo enviada por sus abogados. La carta alegaba, sin aportar pruebas, que en abril de 2023 se transfirieron sin autorización de Recurrent a una filial de Moonshot servidores que contenían datos vitales de modelos de lenguaje a gran escala, y que en septiembre de 2024 se eliminaron otros datos clave siguiendo instrucciones de Zhang Yutao. Recurrent y sus inversionistas también están barajando la posibilidad de interponer una demanda independiente en Islas Caimán contra la presidenta de Moonshot, Zhang Yutong, según la carta. Zhang Yutong, que dimitió como directora de Recurrent en 2022, recibió una participación accionarial significativa en Moonshot "en beneficio propio, un hecho que se ocultó deliberadamente a los accionistas de Recurrent", se afirma en la carta. Reuters no pudo confirmar esta afirmación. Zhang Yutong tampoco respondió a varias solicitudes de comentarios enviadas por correo electrónico a través de Moonshot. Reuters no pudo determinar si Zhang Yutong se ha pronunciado públicamente sobre las acusaciones. Medios de comunicación chinos, entre ellos la publicación digital respaldada por el Estado The Paper, LatePost —especializada en tecnología— y Tencent News, han informado de que Yang, en una publicación de 2024 en su cuenta personal de la red social WeChat, rechazó las acusaciones de enriquecimiento ilícito y otras irregularidades, afirmando que había llegado a un acuerdo con los miembros del directorio de Recurrent para la creación de Moonshot y que la remuneración de Zhang Yutong se basaba en sus capacidades profesionales. Reuters no pudo acceder a la publicación original. Recurrent recibió el 9,5% de las acciones originales de Moonshot cuando se fundó la "startup". Recurrent y sus inversionistas reclaman una indemnización equivalente al 10,5% de las acciones originales de Moonshot, lo que podría suponer un valor superior a los 700 millones de dólares, de acuerdo con una valoración de 30.000 millones de dólares de Moonshot en una ronda de financiación celebrada en junio, según una de las fuentes. Moonshot ganó popularidad inicialmente gracias a su chatbot Kimi, conocido por su capacidad para procesar documentos extensos. La asociación con Alibaba (9988.HK) de Alibaba contribuyó a darla a conocer, y desde entonces la empresa se ha expandido hacia productos de IA basados en codificación, razonamiento y agentes. En julio, Moonshot presentó Kimi K3, un modelo de 2,8 billones de parámetros que, según la empresa, es el sistema de IA de peso abierto más grande del mundo y ofrece un rendimiento similar al de los modelos de Anthropic. Entre sus otros inversionistas se encuentran Tencent Holdings (0700.HK) , Meituan (3690.HK) y China Mobile (600941.SS) .

item.title: BOURSE L'Europe ouvre dans le vert grâce au récul du pétrole
item.description: Les principales Bourses européennes avancent légèrement lundi en début de séance, les investisseurs évaluant l'annonce américaine d'un cessez-le-feu énergétique entre l'Ukraine et la Russie, tout en se préparant au début de la saison des résultats d'entreprise.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Les principales Bourses européennes avancent légèrement lundi en début de séance, les investisseurs évaluant l'annonce américaine d'un cessez-le-feu énergétique entre l'Ukraine et la Russie, tout en se préparant au début de la saison des résultats d'entreprise. À Paris, le CAC 40 (.FCHI) gagne 0,59% à 7.849,40 points vers 07h30 GMT. À Francfort, le Dax (.GDAXI) avance de 0,56% et à Londres, le FTSE 100 (.FTSE) prend 0,51%. L'indice EuroStoxx 50 (.STOXX50E) gagne 0,67%, le FTSEurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) 0,55% et le Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) 0,55%. Le marché analyse les répercussions de l'annonce faite dimanche par Washington, selon laquelle la Russie et l'Ukraine auraient conclu un accord de cessez-le-feu concernant les infrastructures énergétiques. Les cours du pétrole reculent légèrement, ce qui freine les rendements obligataires et soutient les actions, bien que le dirigeant ukrainien, Volodimir Zelensky, ait rapidement démenti cet accord, tandis que Moscou n'a pour l'instant fait aucun commentaire. [USN:L8N45Y0AE TEXT:"L'escalade des tensions"] entre les Houthis yéménites et l'Arabie saoudite impose en outre une certaine prudence, la situation restant très instable au Moyen-Orient, au coeur d'un conflit qui s'enlise et qui attise les craintes d'inflation dans le monde entier. Les investisseurs restent également attentifs aux tensions sur le marché de la dette souveraine, notamment en France, même s'il reste relativement calme en ce début de semaine, en partie en raison de l'absence des investisseurs sur le marché obligataire américain à l'occasion de la fête de Christophe Colomb. "La situation française est bien entendu à suivre de près, d'autant plus par son caractère systémique pour la zone euro. Il est toutefois nécessaire, pour les investisseurs, de prendre du recul vis-à-vis d'une situation européenne loin d'être si mauvaise dans sa globalité", souligne Enguerrand Artaz, stratégiste chez la Financière de l'Échiquier (LFDE). La séance est pauvre en indicateurs macroéconomiques, mais la semaine s'annonce néanmoins intense avec les chiffres de l'inflation américaine et les résultats des banques de Wall Street prévus dans les prochains jours. Dans la zone euro, le géant du luxe LVMH (LVMH.PA) donnera le coup d'envoi de la publication des résultats du troisième trimestre après la clôture. Aux valeurs, Nexans (NEXS.PA) gagne 1,55% après que Jefferies a relevé sa recommandation sur la valeur. Vallourec SA (VLLP.PA) grimpe de 4,47% après avoir remporté un contrat majeur avec TotalEnergies (TTEF.PA) pour le champ gazier d'Absheron en Azerbaïdjan. Le secteur automobile se distingue, Renault (RENA.PA) progressant de 3,2%, Valeo (VLOF.PA) de 2,2%, Forvia (FRVIA.PA) de 3,4%, après que la Chine et l'Union européenne (UE) sont parvenues à un accord visant à réduire de plus de moitié les exportations chinoises de voitures hybrides vers le bloc. Stellantis (STLAM.MI) prend 2,20% et Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) 1,47%, bien que ce dernier [USN:L6N45Y0AJ TEXT:"ait annoncé"] une baisse de ses livraisons trimestrielles. Le titre Nordex (NDXG.DE) prend 2,5%, le fabricant d'éoliennes ayant annoncé que ses prises de commandes de projets au troisième trimestre avaient augmenté de 30% par rapport à la même période de l'année précédente.

item.title: El auge de vehículos híbridos chinos en la UE se enfrenta a nuevas restricciones ante el acuerdo
item.description: El acuerdo de China con la Unión Europea para limitar las exportaciones de vehículos híbridos al bloque supone un nuevo revés para los fabricantes chinos de vehículos eléctricos, que han incrementado los envíos de híbridos —exentos de los aranceles de la UE sobre los vehículos eléctricos fabricados en China— ante la ralentización del crecimiento de las ventas en el mercado nacional.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El acuerdo de China con la Unión Europea para limitar las exportaciones de vehículos híbridos al bloque supone un nuevo revés para los fabricantes chinos de vehículos eléctricos, que han incrementado los envíos de híbridos —exentos de los aranceles de la UE sobre los vehículos eléctricos fabricados en China— ante la ralentización del crecimiento de las ventas en el mercado nacional. Las exportaciones chinas de vehículos híbridos a los 27 Estados miembros de la UE se triplicaron hasta alcanzar los 7.500 millones de dólares en el primer semestre de este año, frente a los 2.500 millones del año anterior, según datos de las aduanas chinas. La cifra fue casi nueve veces superior a los 845 millones de dólares exportados en todo el año 2021. Desde que la UE impuso más aranceles a los vehículos eléctricos fabricados en China en 2024, los fabricantes de automóviles chinos han recurrido cada vez más a los híbridos enchufables, que están exentos de dichos aranceles. La escasa infraestructura de recarga en algunas zonas de Europa también ha favorecido la demanda de híbridos enchufables, que se comercializan por su gran autonomía y su bajo consumo de combustible. SAIC (600104.SS) , BYD (1211.HK) y Chery (9973.HK) representaron más del 90% del volumen de ventas de híbridos chinos en la UE, mientras que los híbridos supusieron más de la mitad de sus ventas en Europa, según Jefferies. "SE ELIMINA EL RIESGO ARANCELARIO, PERO APARECE EL DE CUOTAS" Aunque el comisario europeo de Comercio, Maros Sefcovic, dijo el viernes que el acuerdo reduciría las importaciones en "varios millones de vehículos durante cuatro años", Bruselas y Pekín aún no han revelado cómo se aplicará el acuerdo. El Ministerio de Comercio de China dijo el lunes que el acuerdo permitirá un crecimiento continuado de las exportaciones y garantizará a China una cuota no inferior a la concedida a cualquier otra fuente de importaciones. Los inversionistas interpretaron en gran medida el acuerdo como una distensión comercial y una señal de que los aranceles sobre los híbridos chinos podrían quedar descartados por el momento. Las acciones de BYD caían un 1,8%, mientras que las de Chery y SAIC subían un 0,25% y un 0,4%, respectivamente. "En general, creemos que se trata de un repunte motivado por el alivio del riesgo (…) ya que las normas de aplicación, los límites de volumen, los precios mínimos y las excepciones aún están pendientes de negociación técnica", señalaron los analistas de Citi. El rápido crecimiento de las ventas de híbridos chinos ha supuesto un reto cada vez mayor para los fabricantes europeos, entre ellos Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) , que durante mucho tiempo ha sido el principal vendedor de híbridos enchufables de la región, según Li Yanwei, analista de la Asociación China de Concesionarios de Automóviles. BYD, el mayor exportador chino de vehículos híbridos a Europa, vendió más híbridos enchufables que modelos totalmente eléctricos en los primeros ocho meses del año, siendo su SUV Seal U el modelo con más ventas, según los datos recopilados por Li. Junto con Chery, SAIC y Geely, la empresa ha reducido la distancia con Volkswagen, que aún ostenta una cuota del 31,8% del mercado de híbridos enchufables de la UE. "Veamos si China respeta el acuerdo o busca soluciones alternativas, o exenciones arancelarias temporales", dijo Michael Dunne, un consultor que sigue de cerca la industria automovilística china. Los analistas señalaron que el acuerdo acelerará la apuesta de los fabricantes de automóviles chinos por aumentar la producción en Europa. "Es de esperar que esto refuerce el incentivo para que los fabricantes de automóviles chinos produzcan en Europa", señaló Bill Russo, fundador de la consultora Automobility, en Shanghái. "Si el acceso a través de las importaciones se vuelve más restringido, invertir más cerca del cliente resulta más atractivo. Pero la localización requiere capital, (…) es posible que los actores más pequeños se replanteen sus ambiciones europeas". Los analistas de Jefferies señalaron que el acuerdo suponía "el fin del riesgo arancelario y el inicio del riesgo de cuotas", lo que podría empujar a los fabricantes de automóviles chinos hacia modelos de mayor precio, aumentando la presión sobre las marcas prémium alemanas y acelerando los planes para fabricar más vehículos en Europa.

item.title: Le Pen y Mélenchon pasarían a segunda vuelta ante una mayor polarización en Francia, según encuesta
item.description: La líder de extrema derecha francesa Marine Le Pen y su rival de izquierda Jean-Luc Mélenchon ampliaron su ventaja sobre el resto de candidatos y se enfrentarían en una segunda vuelta en todos los escenarios analizados, según reveló una encuesta este lunes, que pone de relieve la creciente polarización a medida que llega a su fin la era del presidente Emmanuel Macron.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La líder de extrema derecha francesa Marine Le Pen y su rival de izquierda Jean-Luc Mélenchon ampliaron su ventaja sobre el resto de candidatos y se enfrentarían en una segunda vuelta en todos los escenarios analizados, según reveló una encuesta este lunes, que pone de relieve la creciente polarización a medida que llega a su fin la era del presidente Emmanuel Macron. Le Pen encabezaría la primera vuelta con entre un 35% y un 37%, según los escenarios analizados por la empresa de sondeos Toluna Harris Interactive en una encuesta realizada entre el 5 y el 8 de octubre. Una encuesta similar del mes pasado la situaba entre el 33% y el 36%. Mélenchon, el candidato del partido de izquierda Francia Insumisa (LFI, por sus siglas en francés), llegaría a la segunda vuelta en los cinco escenarios analizados. Una encuesta similar del mes pasado lo situaba en tercer lugar en dos de los cinco escenarios analizados. Se prevé que Le Pen venza fácilmente a Mélenchon en una segunda vuelta. A medida que el segundo y último mandato de cinco años de Macron llega a su fin, el impopular presidente deja tras de sí un centro político vaciado y una economía débil, lo que abre una brecha para los partidos de línea dura, como Francia Insumisa y Reagrupamiento Nacional. Mélenchon ya se ha presentado tres veces a las elecciones presidenciales, en 2012, 2017 y 2022, pero nunca ha logrado pasar a la segunda vuelta. Le Pen también se ha presentado en esas mismas tres ocasiones. Llegó a la segunda vuelta en 2017 y 2022, pero perdió frente a Macron.

item.title: India wastes 4% of solar power amid power shortages in July, August, report shows
item.description: India turned away nearly 1.8 billion units of renewable electricity in July and August, even as it grappled with power shortages and dwindling coal stocks at power plants during a period of record electricity demand, a report showed on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Sethuraman R
item.content:encoded: India turned away nearly 1.8 billion units of renewable electricity in July and August, even as it grappled with power shortages and dwindling coal stocks at power plants during a period of record electricity demand, a report showed on Monday. About 4.2% of total solar generation could not be absorbed by the grid in July and August, highlighting inadequate transmission infrastructure, data from the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA) showed. The data highlight a growing challenge for India as it expands renewable energy capacity to meet its clean energy targets of 500 gigawatts (GW) by 2030 from the present 304 GW. "Despite record renewable generation, significant volumes of renewable electricity continued to be curtailed because of grid and operational constraints," CREA analysts said. India, the world's third-biggest solar power generator, [USN:L4N43U1BW TEXT:"held back"] 14% of its solar power output between April and June, according to government data. The South Asian nation's transmission network has struggled to keep pace with the increase in green energy, particularly solar, which accounts for about 168 GW, or nearly a third of its power generation capacity, according to government figures. The clean power curbs came even as peak power demand touched 270 GW in July and coal inventories at power stations fell sharply, the energy think tank said. Nearly [USN:L4N45R0ZP TEXT:"half"] of the country's coal plants had stocks under four days of their requirement early this month. India added renewable capacity at a rapid pace over the past year, helping non-fossil sources account for more than half of the country's installed power capacity. Solar generation jumped 39% from a year earlier during the quarter ended September, while renewable generation excluding large hydro crossed 100 billion units for the first time. Coal remained the backbone of India's power system during the quarter, supplying about two-thirds of electricity despite record renewable generation, as rising demand and a 20% decline in hydropower output linked to the El Niño weather pattern increased reliance on fossil fuels, the report said.

item.title: Le bilan officiel de l'attaque sur l'aéroport de Ryad dimanche établi à un mort et 11 blessés
item.description: L'attaque lancée dimanche contre l'aéroport international de Ryad survenue dimanche a fait un mort et onze blessés, ont annoncé les autorités saoudiennes, frappe survenue au lendemain d'un assaut contre ce même aéroport, revendiqué par les Houthis, qui a fait 13 morts et plus de 300 blessés.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'attaque lancée dimanche contre l'aéroport international de Ryad survenue dimanche a fait un mort et onze blessés, ont annoncé les autorités saoudiennes, frappe survenue au lendemain d'un assaut contre ce même aéroport, revendiqué par les [USN:L8N45W036 TEXT:"Houthis"], qui a fait 13 morts et plus de 300 blessés. Selon la coalition dirigée par l'Arabie saoudite au Yémen, un [USN:L8N45X06H TEXT:""projectile non identifié""] a frappé dimanche le terminal 4 de l'aéroport international du roi Khaled, provoquant un incendie. La coalition a également déclaré que les défenses aériennes saoudiennes avaient intercepté un missile de croisière à proximité de l'aéroport. Elle a ajouté par la suite qu'un drone avait été intercepté et détruit dans la province orientale du pays et qu'un missile balistique tiré en direction de Khamis Mushait avait été intercepté. Des alertes d'urgence ont été lancées à Abha, dans le sud de l'Arabie saoudite, aux premières heures de ce lundi, mais le danger est désormais écarté, a déclaré la Défense civile saoudienne. Environ 60% des vols réguliers prévus à l'aéroport de Ryad devraient être annulés ce lundi, selon les données du cabinet d'analyse aéronautique Cirium, qui précise que la quasi-totalité des vols avait été annulée dimanche.

item.title: Gaza Deux Palestiniens tués par des frappes israéliennes - secours
item.description: Des frappes israéliennes ont tué au moins deux Palestiniens dans la bande de Gaza lundi, selon les autorités sanitaires locales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Des frappes israéliennes ont tué au moins deux Palestiniens dans la bande de Gaza lundi, selon les autorités sanitaires locales. L'armée israélienne a dit qu'elle visait un militant, sans donner plus de détails. Israël, qui affirme que le Hamas s'est réarmé et lance des attaques en violation du cessez-le-feu conclu en octobre 2025, a intensifié ses frappes contre le mouvement ces dernières semaines. Le Hamas nie tenter de mener des attaques ou de reconstituer son arsenal et accuse Israël de violer ce cessez-le-feu et de saper les efforts pour mettre en oeuvre le plan du président américain Donald Trump pour mettre fin au conflit dans la bande de Gaza. Ce plan prévoit entre autres le retrait d'Israël et le désarmement du Hamas. Le cessez-le-feu d'octobre 2025 a mis fin aux combats dans la bande de Gaza, engagés par l'armée israélienne en réponse à l'attaque menée le 7 octobre 2023 par le Hamas dans le sud d'Israël. Cette attaque du Hamas avait fait environ 1.200 morts et entraîné l'enlèvement de 251 otages emmenés à Gaza. Les autorités palestiniennes affirment que plus de 74.000 personnes ont été tuées lors de l'offensive israélienne qui s'en est suivie. Plus de 1.400 Palestiniens ont été tués par Israël dans l'enclave depuis l'entrée en vigueur du cessez-le-feu il y a un an, selon les autorités sanitaires locales, tandis que Tsahal a fait état de la mort de quatre soldats israéliens.

item.title: Las bolsas europeas suben ante la caída de los precios del petróleo y la solidez de la banca
item.description: Las bolsas europeas subían el lunes, impulsadas por los valores bancarios, mientras los precios del petróleo se moderaban ante las esperanzas de un alto el fuego energético entre Rusia y Ucrania, en un momento en que los inversores esperaban el inicio de la temporada de resultados en busca de nuevos catalizadores.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las bolsas europeas subían el lunes, impulsadas por los valores bancarios, mientras los precios del petróleo se moderaban ante las esperanzas de un alto el fuego energético entre Rusia y Ucrania, en un momento en que los inversores esperaban el inicio de la temporada de resultados en busca de nuevos catalizadores. El índice paneuropeo STOXX 600 (.STOXX) avanzaba un 0,43%, hasta los 634,25 puntos, a las 0709 GMT. El IBEX 35 español (.IBEX) , con un fuerte peso del sector bancario, se disparaba un 1,3%, el mayor avance entre los índices regionales. Los [USN:L6N45Y0B2 TEXT:"precios del petróleo"] bajaban ante las expectativas de un aumento de la oferta rusa, después de que el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, afirmara que [USN:L6N45X05P TEXT:"Ucrania y Rusia"] habían acordado detener los ataques contra las instalaciones energéticas de la otra parte, tras un acuerdo entre EEUU y Rusia sobre el suministro de diésel. Los rendimientos de los bonos de la zona del euro se moderaban el lunes, lo que contribuía aún más a mejorar el ánimo hacia los activos de mayor riesgo. Los inversionistas centrarán ahora su atención en los informes de resultados de las empresas europeas para evaluar la salud de las compañías en un contexto de incertidumbre geopolítica y mayores costos de financiación. LVMH (LVMH.PA) publicará sus resultados tras el cierre de los mercados europeos, mientras que el fabricante de equipos semiconductores ASML (ASML.AS) y la empresa de inversiones EQT (EQTAB.ST) lo harán esta semana. Entre otros movimientos bursátiles, Nordex (NDXG.DE) se revalorizaba un 2,5% después de que el fabricante de aerogeneradores terrestres anunciara que su cartera de pedidos de proyectos en el tercer trimestre aumentó un 30% interanual.

item.title: Barrett says All Blacks exile was mentally challenging
item.description: New Zealand playmaker Beauden Barrett's confidence suffered during a lengthy spell out of the All Blacks side but the 35-year-old said he harbours no resentment towards coach Dave Rennie.
item.dc:creator: Ian Ransom
item.content:encoded: New Zealand playmaker Beauden Barrett's confidence suffered during a lengthy spell out of the All Blacks side but the 35-year-old said he harbours no resentment towards coach Dave Rennie. Barrett, capped 146 times by New Zealand, was overlooked for the first six tests of the season before making his return off the bench against South Africa in Baltimore, where he scored a late try. He finally earned a starting berth at fullback against Australia at Eden Park last weekend, helping New Zealand [USN:L1N45W02B TEXT:"thrash the Wallabies 50-19 to retain the Bledisloe Cup"], the annual trophy contested by the trans-Tasman nations, for a 24th straight year. "It did challenge me mentally a little bit," the twice World Rugby Player of the Year said on Monday. "Not being selected and just feeling a little bit off the pace. When you are in the 23 or the 15 you are in the thick of it, you feel that flow, the connections, the combinations and all of that. "I would be lying if I said that it hasn't affected me, but the important thing is that I have just been able to bounce back and focus on what I do well and be consistent." Barrett, previously first-choice flyhalf under former coach Scott Robertson, found himself down the pecking order after Rennie took charge, with 25-year-old Ruben Love preferred at number 10 and Damian McKenzie at fullback. He was relegated to helping the match-day squad prepare at training, but said he had worked hard to regain his confidence. Injuries to Love and Richie Mo'unga have since opened the door for Barrett, who hopes to retain his place for Saturday's second Bledisloe Cup test in Sydney. Barrett said Rennie had been forthright about his standing in the squad. "He was telling me he was liking how I was training, he was happy with my contribution and it was clear that I wasn't up in the pecking order, so I had to really work for it or wait for my opportunity," he added. "We are both honest with one another, we know where we stand and there are no mixed messages."

item.title: Telecom stocks in Australia, NZ slide after SpaceX spectrum deal
item.description: Telecom stocks in Australia and New Zealand tumbled on Monday after SpaceX's acquisition of a nationwide spectrum portfolio in the US stoked fears that satellites could challenge legacy telecom firms and their network coverage.
item.dc:creator: Kumar Tanishk
item.content:encoded: Telecom stocks in Australia and New Zealand tumbled on Monday after SpaceX's (SPCX.O) acquisition of a nationwide spectrum portfolio in the US stoked fears that satellites could challenge legacy telecom firms and their network coverage. Australia's top telecom firm Telstra (TLS.AX) shed 2.5% to finish at a six-week low, while no.3 operator, TPG Telecom (TPG.AX) , lost nearly 5% in its worst day since early June. Spark New Zealand (SPK.NZ) slipped 1.8%. Here are some details: ** SpaceX last week [USN:L6N45U1AK TEXT:"struck a deal"] to buy a nationwide low-band spectrum portfolio, moving Elon Musk's satellite venture closer to mounting a direct, orbital challenge to legacy wireless giants across the United States. ** That sent [USN:L4N45V0PU TEXT:"telecom stocks in the U.S. and Europe"] tumbling on concerns over growing competition from satellite-based mobile services. ** Low-band spectrum can [USN:L4N45V0TK TEXT:"travel"] longer distances and penetrate buildings and other obstacles more effectively than higher-frequency airwaves. ** "Investors fear the U.S. is just the first market, and that incumbents' biggest advantage, coverage, is losing its value," said David Tuckwell, CIO at ETF Shares in Sydney. ** Tuckwell sees coverage-reliant Telstra as most exposed, though the near-term threat is to regional pricing power, not subscribers. ** Citi analysts said, "While SpaceX's spectrum purchase is likely to weigh on Telstra's share price, it also shows the importance of having terrestrial spectrum". ** Citi reiterated their "buy" call on Telstra citing upside to 2027 financial earnings guidance. ** Australia's mobile market is dominated by Telstra, Singapore Telecommunications (STEL.SI) -owned Optus, and TPG Telecom (TPG.AX) , with Superloop (SLC.AX) and Aussie Broadband (ABB.AX) jostling at the fringes. ** Superloop shed 2.4%, while Aussie Broadband lost nearly 2%.
